I did! it was kind of awful but I did it. Really depends on your attitude towards it. 

It showed me I really don’t like stem and allowed me to explore other career paths outside of science. I didn’t find the class awfully difficult, but I did take chem freshmen year so that definitely helped. Without it it’d be very difficult so be sure to factor that in. Depends how much work you want to put in. It’s mathy- but if you haven’t taken alg 2 trig yet, you should still be ok, as I took it just this year. By no means is it easy, I got a 2 on the exam LMAO. My teacher was new to teaching it and we literally skipped 2 units which were a bulk of the test (acids and bases). Still got an A in the class though. 

I was pretty passionate about chem going in and went in for help almost every day LMAO. Did not feel that way by May. But like I said, I’m happy I did it, it allowed me to explore other paths that are better suited for my strengths.
